name: Ugonyo lwabantwana
tagline: Ishedyuli yasimahla yoMzantsi Afrika. Yonke imbumbulu ibalulekile.

what_is_it.heading: Ugonyo lwabantwana ngokwemiqathango ecacileyo
what_is_it.lede: Izitofu zokugonya ziqeqesha amajoni omzimba omntwana ukuba akwazi ukulwa nezifo phambi kokuba adibane nazo kubomi benene. INkqubo eYandisiweyo yoGonyo yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-EPI-SA) ikhusela ezona zifo zibulalayo kubantwana - zonke zisimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente.
paragraphs: Isitofu sokugonya sifundisa umzimba ukuba wazi intsholongwane okanye ibhaktiriya ngokuyibonisa inguqulelo engenabungozi. Xa into yokwenene ifika, amajoni omzimba alungele. Izitofu zokugonya zithintele izigidi zokufa kwihlabathi jikelele - imasisi iyodwa esetyenziselwa ukubulala abantwana abazizigidi ezi-2.6 ngonyaka phambi kwesitofu sokugonya.

Ishedyuli yoMzantsi Afrika iqala ekuzalweni kwayo kwaye iqhubeleka kwiminyaka yokuya esikolweni. Hlala kuyo. Ukuphoswa kwesithonga esinye akuzilungisi ezinye, kodwa kushiya isithuba sokhuseleko. Ukuba usalele ngasemva, ungabamba – thetha nekliniki. Incwadi ethi Road to Health ilandelela idosi nganye.

items.headline: Izifo ezininzi
items.body: Ishedyuli yasimahla yoMzantsi Afrika ikhusela iTB, ipoliyo, imasisi, ihepatitis B, pneumococcal, rotavirus, HPV, nokunye.

items.headline: Konke simahla
items.body: Isitofu ngasinye esikwishedyuli sisimahla kuzo zonke iikliniki zikarhulumente. Akukho ncedo lwezonyango, akukho dinga lufunekayo ukulungiselela ukudutyulwa kwesiqhelo.

items.headline: Incwadi yeNdlela esingise eMpilweni
items.body: Wonke umntwana waseMzantsi Afrika ufumana incwadi yeNdlela esingisa eMpilweni ekuzalweni kwakhe. Yizise kutyelelo ngalunye lwekliniki - ilandelela lonke ugonyo, ubunzima, kunye nenqanaba elibalulekileyo.

items.headline: Ibuyile imasisi
items.body: Ukwehla kwamazinga ogonyo kubuyisele uqhambuko lwemasisi eMzantsi Afrika. Imasisi inokubulala, iyimfama, okanye ibangele umonakalo engqondweni. Isitofu sokugonya sikhuselekile kwaye siyasebenza.

pull_quote.text: Ugonyo lolona ngenelelo lwezempilo lungabizi kakhulu kwimbali yoluntu. IRandi nganye echithwayo kugonyo lwabantwana isindisa abaninzi ngakumbi kwiindleko zokhathalelo lwempilo - nangaphezulu kakhulu ebomini.

signs.heading: Ishedyuli yobuntwana yaseMzantsi Afrika
signs.lede: Apha kuxa umntwana wakho efumana isitofu sokugonya ngasinye. Iiveki ezi-6, iiveki ezili-10, iiveki ezili-14, iinyanga ezisi-9, kunye notyelelo lweenyanga ezili-18 zezona zibalulekileyo—ungaze uzitsibe.

items.title: Ekuzalweni
items.description: I-BCG (nxamnye ne-TB) kunye nepoliyo yomlomo yokuqala iyehla. Inikwe ngaphambi kokuba umama nosana baphume kwiwadi yokubeleka.

items.title: 6, 10, kunye neeveki ezili-14
items.description: I-Pentavalent (i-5-in-1: i-diphtheria, i-tetanus, i-pertussis, i-Hib, i-hepatitis B), i-rotavirus drops, i-pneumococcal, i-polio. Lonke utyelelo lwasekliniki olufanayo.

items.title: 9 kunye 18 iinyanga
items.description: Isitofu sokugonya imasisi kutyelelo zombini, kunye nezincedisi kwiinyanga ezili-18. Ibalulekile kukhuseleko lwemasisi - ungaze utsibe ezi.

items.title: Iminyaka yesikolo
items.description: I-Tetanus kunye ne-diphtheria booster kwi-6 kunye ne-12 iminyaka. Ugonyo lwe-HPV kwiBanga lesi-5 kumantombazana (kunye namakhwenkwe kumaphondo amaninzi) — ngeprogram yesikolo.

items.fact: Amashumi eminyaka ezifundo ezinkulu kwizigidi zabantwana azibonisi nxibelelwano phakathi kogonyo kunye noluphazamiseko. Uphononongo lwakuqala luka-1998 lwafunyaniswa lunobuqhophololo kwaye lwarhoxiswa. Umbhali uphulukene nephepha-mvume lakhe lonyango.

items.myth: Usulelo lwendalo lunika ukhuseleko olungcono kunezitofu zokugonya.
items.fact: Usulelo lwendalo ngamanye amaxesha lunika ukhuseleko olunamandla - kodwa ngexabiso lesi sifo ngokwaso. Imasisi inokubulala okanye ibangele umonakalo engqondweni. Ipoliyo inokukhubazeka. Izitofu zokugonya zinika ukhuseleko ngaphandle kwengozi.

items.myth: Izitofu ezininzi zokugonya ezisondelelene kakhulu zongamela amajoni omzimba.
items.fact: Umxokomezelo wosana wokuzikhusela kwizifo ulawula amawakawaka eentsholongwane mihla le ngokuphefumla kuphela. Iiprotheyini ezimbalwa kwisitofu sokugonya yithontsi elwandle. Ishedyuli imiselwe ukukhusela kwawona minyaka isengozini.

items.myth: Ukuba wonke umntu ugonyiwe, umntwana wam akayifuni.
items.fact: Ukugonywa komhlambi kusebenza kuphela xa abantu abaninzi begonyiwe. Njengoko amazinga ogonyo ehla, izifo ziyabuya - njengoko sibona ngemasisi eMzantsi Afrika. Musa ukuba ngumsantsa.

prevention.heading: Ukufumana nokulandelela amayeza okugonya
prevention.lede: Izitofu zokugonya zisebenza ngcono xa zinikwe ngexesha nangendlela eyiyo. Inkqubo yekliniki yenza kube lula ukuba uza nencwadi.

items.title: Gcina incwadi yeNdlela esingisa eMpilweni
items.description: Utyelelo ngalunye lwasekliniki luhamba kule ncwadi. Yincwadana yokundwendwela yomntwana wakho yeminyaka emi-6 yokuqala. Yigcine ikhuselekile kwaye uyizise ngalo lonke ixesha.

items.title: Namathela kwishedyuli
items.description: Ugonyo olungexesha lukhusela kweyona minyaka isengozini. Ukuba uphose ithamo, iklinikhi iyakufumana - sukulinda unyaka ozayo.

items.title: Iimpendulo ezithambileyo ziqhelekile
items.description: Umkhuhlane omncinci, ububomvu, okanye ukuxakaniseka kwimini okanye ezimbini emva kokugonywa yinto eqhelekileyo. IParacetamol iyanceda. Ukusabela okubukhali kunqabile kakhulu — yiya ekliniki ukuba unexhala.

items.title: Izitofu zokubamba kunye nokuhamba
items.description: Ukuba umntwana wakho uphosile ukufota okanye uhamba phesheya, buza iklinikhi malunga neeshedyuli zokubambisa kunye nezitofu zokuhamba. Uninzi lweedosi eziphosiweyo zinokunikwa kamva.

items.title: Jonga incwadi yeNdlela esingisa eMpilweni
items.description: Vula iphepha logonyo. Jonga ukuba zeziphi izithonga zomntwana wakho kwaye zeziphi ezifunekayo. Ukuba awunayo incwadi, buza ikliniki — baya kukukhupha.

items.title: Ukuba umntwana wakho uphelelwe lixesha - hamba ngoku
items.description: Ngena kuyo nayiphi na ikliniki nencwadi. Ugonyo oluninzi oluphosiweyo lunokunikwa kwangolo suku olunye. Akukho sigqibo, akukho ndleko eyongezelelweyo.

items.title: Ukuba ulahlekelwe yincwadi
items.description: Iikliniki ezininzi zineerekhodi ze-elektroniki kwaye zidla ngokujonga oko kunikiweyo. Iincwadi ezitshintshiweyo zisimahla.

items.title: Ukuba umntwana wakho uye wasabela ngaphambili
items.description: Xelela ikliniki. Uninzi lweempendulo ezidlulileyo aziwathinteli amayeza exesha elizayo - iindlela ezizezinye okanye izilumkiso ziyafumaneka.

items.title: Ukuba intombi yakho ikwiBanga lesi-5
items.description: Qinisekisa ukuba ufumana isitofu sasimahla se-HPV ngenkqubo yesikolo. Iidosi ezimbini, zishiyana ngeenyanga ezintandathu. Ithintela uninzi lomhlaza womlomo wesibeleko.

get_help.heading: Masiye phi
get_help.lede: Inkqubo yogonyo loMzantsi Afrika yenye yezona ndawo zifikelelekayo kwinkqubo yezempilo. Yiza nomntwana wakho kunye nencwadi ethi Indlela esingisa eMpilweni.
